proposed_widenings.name: save_gate.targetRollModifier
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell grants the target Advantage on its saving throw under a specific condition (caster or allies are fighting the target). The current save_gate phase has no field to express conditional roll modifiers on the target's throw at cast time. A new optional field — e.g. targetRollModifier: { mode: 'advantage' | 'disadvantage', condition: ... } — on ActivationPhase save_gate would cover this and the same pattern in Charm Person.
proposed_widenings.evidence: It does so with Advantage if you or your allies are fighting it.

proposed_widenings.name: Duration.timed_with_break
proposed_widenings.justification: The charm ends early when the target takes damage from the caster or their allies. The current timed Duration variant only models a fixed time window. A new variant (or an optional breakOn field on timed) is needed to express event-triggered early expiry. The same pattern appears in Charm Person and many other charm/compulsion spells.
proposed_widenings.evidence: the target has the Charmed condition until the spell ends or until you or your allies damage it

notes: Core mechanics encode cleanly: activation family, single save_gate phase, WIS save, apply_condition:charmed on fail, timed 1-hour duration, slot-scaled choose_up_to targeting. Typecheck passes; tracer emits a valid graph. Two secondary mechanics are omitted: (1) conditional advantage on the save when fighting the target — needs a new variant on save_gate; (2) damage-triggered early expiry — needs an early-break condition on the Duration timed variant. Both are surface shape gaps, not missing v4 atoms.
